facts.fact: PO-RALG's minister told the National Assembly that by February 2023, 169 councils had started to use TAUSI, which replaced LGRCIS in 2022/23; no total of councils is given in this document.
PO-RALG built TAUSI to fix problems of LGRCIS, in use from the 2022/23 financial year, with USAID PS3+ support to the revenue system.
